title: Error v1
description: Every refusal the ERP sends a POS. Branch on `code` and `details.reason`, never on `message`, which is English text for people.

code.description: `POS_CREDENTIAL_REJECTED` (401): stop the queue, keep pending events pending, and tell an administrator. `SALES_EVENT_REJECTED` (422): this event will never be accepted as it is; dead-letter it (nothing was stored, so the same key can be resent once the cause is fixed). Anything else: see the HTTP status and contracts/README.md.

reason.description: The same value the ERP logs and counts as `reason` (docs/TELEMETRY.md).

errors.description: For `schema_invalid`: where the event breaks the schema.
